title: Good, not great, towels
text:
Good, not great, towels. On the positive side, the towels are fairly well made and absorbent. They are a good size for a bath towel and dry well. On the slightly negative side, the towels are not very thick and, after a couple of washes, still fairly stiff and starchy.

You are not going to go wrong buying these towels for everyday use. I believe that they will hold up well. Just do not expect to get $100 luxury towels at a deep miscount when you order these towels. Overall, I give them a slightly above average value.
